data.name: Salticidae Story
data.detailed_description:
Coming next

Salticidae Story is growing all the time. Here is what we are building now and roughly when we hope each part lands. Times can move, and we will post every change in the game's news.

[Winter 2026]
  • The Leaf-Litter Derby: race your beetles and roaches through the leaf litter against other keepers, on new tracks with twists and obstacles every time
  • A Derby trackside next to the Station, with bleachers to watch the races from
  • Beetle breeding: the beetles you keep lay eggs, and the larvae grow into new beetles
  • A new ship to live in: a fresh ship interior, and you fly from the pilot's chair
  • Your own spiders and bugs out for a walk around your ship
  • Bug jars and bigger shelves, and wild worlds that get wilder the further you fly
  • A one-on-one spider duel against a friend
  • Rain, new music and calmer sounds when you are out exploring

[Early 2027]
  • Spider Wars: a spider battle game in the Arcade

[Spring 2027]
  • Bigger worlds: hills, rivers, ponds, far mountains and the sea, and worlds that wrap all the way round

[All year]
  • New outfits and hats for your Keeper

A tiny ship, and a shelf of spiders

Your ship's cabin has a shelf of tanks, and every tank is a home. Feed your jumping spiders, mist their tanks and watch them grow. When one stops eating, a moult is coming: help it through, and it comes out bigger than before.

Walk out of your cabin to the Station. The Pet Store and the Arcade live on your Fieldphone: open the Pet Store for the feeders your spiders need, from fruit flies for the tiniest slings to crickets for the grown-ups.

Make your Keeper yours

Pick a body colour, a shape, eyes, ears and a hat. Then get dressed: overalls, a raincoat, a bee suit, a cape, a cosy knit, and space suits with bubble helmets for the trip between worlds. Your Keeper walks, runs, waves and sits, and turns to look at the bugs nearby.

Bugs to catch outside

Head out to the meadow and the garden. Sneak up on wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, swing your net, and see if it holds. Every catch goes into your Field Guide, and saved moults go in your trophy case.

Catching is gentle. A bug that gets away just runs off to try again another day.

Genes that really work

Every spider carries a genome of 120 traits: colour, morph, markings, fangs and more. They pass from parents to babies the way real genes do. Some are dominant, some are recessive, and some hide for a generation before they show up again.

  • Pair two spiders and see what their babies could look like before you choose
  • A clutch hatches and you keep three. Picking which three is the fun part
  • Six species cross into hybrids, and each cross has its own colour tell
  • Raise spiders to grow your Keeper level, raise clutches to grow your Breeder level, and new species join your shelf

Other keepers about

Walk the Station and the meadow with other keepers and say hello with picture emotes. You can hide anyone you would rather not see.

An Arcade full of spiders

Open the Arcade on your Fieldphone. Trapline and The Nursery are online: jump into a quick match, or open a room and share its code with a friend. Your own spiders play, so the spider you bred is the one you play with.

  • Trapline: four keepers, one board, and a lot of silk
  • The Nursery: eat, grow, moult and pounce. Every moult levels your spider up
  • Last Leap, Spider Arena and Spider Show: more ways to put your spiders up against your friends'

How it works

  • Fair by design. Every rule runs on our servers, so nobody can cheat their spiders ahead.
  • Saved with your account. Sign in with Steam, and your spiders are kept safe on our servers.
  • 58 achievements across catching, keeping, breeding and the arcade, from your first catch to goals that take months.

data.short_description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11
  • Processador: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Any graphics device with hardware-accelerated 2D (integrated graphics is fine)
  • Rede: Ligação à Internet de banda larga
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 200 MB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: Internet connection required: the game runs on a server and nothing is stored locally. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (built into Windows 11 and current Windows 10; free from Microsoft if missing).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits

linux_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo: Ubuntu 24.04, 64-bit
  • Processador: x86_64, 4 virtual CPU cores
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: OpenGL using Mesa software rendering
